ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides rising-edge timing for the sequencer and synchronizer processes, driving updates of internal shift registers and output ports on each clock edge.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) in sequencer and synchronizer processes (process(rstn_ext_i, clk_i) ... elsif rising_edge(clk_i) then)

ports.name: rstn_ext_i
ports.functionality: Acts as an asynchronous active-low reset that, when '0', forces internal shift registers and all outputs low immediately; otherwise allows clocked update behaviour to proceed.
role: overrides outputs and registers when asserted
ports.evidence: if (rstn_ext_i = '0') then ... branches in both sequencer and synchronizer processes (reset assignments to registers and outputs)

ports.name: rstn_wdt_i
ports.function: watchdog reset input and sampled source
ports.functionality: Participates as a control input that clears the system shift register when low; is also sampled on clock edges and forwarded to xrstn_wdt_o when not in external reset.
role: sampled and exported to watchdog reset output
ports.evidence: used in if (rstn_wdt_i = '0') or (rstn_dbg_i = '0') then sreg_sys <= (others => '0'); and xrstn_wdt_o <= rstn_wdt_i in synchronizer rising_edge branch

ports.name: rstn_dbg_i
ports.function: debug reset input and sampled source
ports.functionality: Acts as a control input that clears the system shift register when low; is sampled on clock edges and forwarded to xrstn_ocd_o when not in external reset.
role: sampled and exported to debug/OCD reset output
ports.evidence: used in if (rstn_wdt_i = '0') or (rstn_dbg_i = '0') then sreg_sys <= (others => '0'); and xrstn_ocd_o <= rstn_dbg_i in synchronizer rising_edge branch

ports.name: rstn_ext_o
ports.functionality: Reports the external reset state: forced '0' during async external reset, otherwise updated on clock edges from the reduction of the sreg_ext shift register and exported off-chip.
ports.evidence: rstn_ext_o <= '0' in reset branch; rstn_ext_o <= and_reduce_f(sreg_ext) in sequencer rising_edge branch

ports.name: rstn_sys_o
ports.functionality: Reports the system reset state: forced '0' during async external reset, otherwise updated each clock from the reduction of sreg_sys which is cleared by watchdog or debug signals when asserted.
ports.evidence: rstn_sys_o <= '0' in reset branch; rstn_sys_o <= and_reduce_f(sreg_sys) in sequencer rising_edge branch; sreg_sys cleared by rstn_wdt_i or rstn_dbg_i

ports.name: xrstn_wdt_o
ports.functionality: Held '0' during external async reset; otherwise captures rstn_wdt_i on the rising clock edge and exports the sampled value as the synchronized watchdog reset output.
ports.evidence: xrstn_wdt_o <= '0' in synchronizer reset branch; xrstn_wdt_o <= rstn_wdt_i in synchronizer rising_edge branch

ports.name: xrstn_ocd_o
ports.functionality: Held '0' during external async reset; otherwise captures rstn_dbg_i on the rising clock edge and exports the sampled value as the synchronized debug/OCD reset output.
ports.evidence: xrstn_ocd_o <= '0' in synchronizer reset branch; xrstn_ocd_o <= rstn_dbg_i in synchronizer rising_edge branch

ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising edge that sequences the ticker process; its rising_edge triggers capture/update of en, cnt and cnt2 in the clocked process.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) in process ticker guards assignments to en, cnt and cnt2

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: When low, asynchronously forces en, cnt and cnt2 to their reset values (zeros), overriding normal clocked updates.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then branch in process ticker assigns en, cnt, cnt2 to zeros

ports.name: enable_i
ports.functionality: Supplies a vector that is OR-reduced; the reduction or_reduce_f(enable_i) is captured into en on the clock edge and thus controls counting.
ports.evidence: en <= or_reduce_f(enable_i) inside rising_edge branch of process ticker

ports.name: clk_en_o
ports.functionality: Provides eight combinational pulse outputs derived from transitions of selected cnt bits and their previous values in cnt2; each assigned as cnt(n) and not cnt2(n).
ports.evidence: concurrent assignments like clk_en_o(clk_div2_c) <= cnt(0) and (not cnt2(0)) for listed bit indices

signals.name: sreg_sys
signals.functionality: 4-bit register that holds system reset shift state; cleared asynchronously by external reset or by watchdog/debug conditions, otherwise shifts its previous bits and appends '1' on each rising clock to deassert reset over time.
signals.evidence: sreg_sys <= (others => '0') in reset and when (rstn_wdt_i='0') or (rstn_dbg_i='0'); else sreg_sys <= sreg_sys(sreg_sys'left-1 downto 0) & '1'; rstn_sys_o <= and_reduce_f(sreg_sys)

signals.name: sreg_ext
signals.functionality: 4-bit register that holds external reset shift state; cleared asynchronously by external reset, otherwise shifts previous bits and appends '1' each clock; its reduction controls rstn_ext_o.
signals.evidence: sreg_ext <= (others => '0') in reset branch; else sreg_ext <= sreg_ext(sreg_ext'left-1 downto 0) & '1'; rstn_ext_o <= and_reduce_f(sreg_ext)

signals.name: en
signals.functionality: Captures the OR-reduction of enable_i each clock; when '1' it permits cnt to increment, otherwise cnt is forced to zero; reset sets it to '0'.
signals.evidence: en <= or_reduce_f(enable_i) under rising_edge; if (en = '1') then cnt <= unsigned(cnt)+1 else cnt <= (others=>'0') in ticker

signals.name: cnt
signals.functionality: Increments by one on each rising_edge while en='1', resets to zero otherwise and on async reset; its bits feed pulse generation and are copied into cnt2 each cycle.
signals.evidence: cnt <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(cnt)+1) and cnt2 <= cnt in ticker; cnt(n) used in concurrent clk_en_o assignments

signals.name: cnt2
signals.functionality: Captures cnt each clock edge (cnt2 <= cnt) and resets to zero on reset; its bits are compared to cnt bits to detect rising edges used for clk_en_o pulses.
signals.evidence: cnt2 <= cnt in rising_edge branch of ticker; cnt2(n) used in clk_en_o concurrent assignments
